skills.description: Authorization with RBAC and ABAC: `can`, `authorize`, `gate`, `gateAny`, `definePolicy`, `hasRole`, `access` and `AccessResolver`. Use for "check a permission", "only the owner can edit", route policies, tenant roles or custom permission storage. Not this package → @warlock.js/auth for login, tokens and user-type guards; @warlock.js/seal for request validation.

Provider-neutral AI agents, tools, workflows, memory, RAG and multimodal calls. Exports `ai`, `humanApproval`, `guardrail`, `team`, `MockModel` and `countInputTokens`. Use for "run an agent", "define a tool", "stream a response", "add approval" or "track token cost". Not this package → @warlock.js/ai-tools for MCP and web tools; @warlock.js/ai-workspace for file/shell tools; @warlock.js/ai-openai for provider setup.

Anthropic Claude adapter for Warlock AI: `AnthropicSDK`, `AnthropicModel`, `AnthropicCallOptions` and `ANTHROPIC_MODEL_PRICING`. Use for "connect Claude", streaming, tools, thinking, caching, native search or context management through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents and custom tools; @warlock.js/ai-bedrock for Claude on AWS; @warlock.js/ai-cli for terminal agents.

Amazon Bedrock adapter for Warlock AI: `BedrockSDK`, `BedrockCallOptions`, `bedrockPricingFor` and regional pricing registries. Use for "run Claude on AWS", "configure Bedrock credentials", Converse streaming, tools, caching or Titan embeddings through `model()` and `embedder()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai-anthropic for direct Anthropic access; @warlock.js/ai for orchestration.

Run installed coding-agent CLIs with `cli`, `createCliAgent`, `cliModel`, `CliAdapter` and `jsonLinesParser`. Use for "run Claude Code or Codex", "resume a CLI session", stream tool/usage events, configure permissions or write an adapter. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for provider-neutral agents; @warlock.js/ai-workspace for embedded file/shell tools; @warlock.js/process for general child processes.

DeepSeek adapter for Warlock AI: `DeepSeekSDK`, `DEEPSEEK_CHAT_MODELS`, `DEEPSEEK_DEFAULT_PRICING` and `DEEPSEEK_OFF_PEAK_PRICING`. Use for "connect DeepSeek", reasoning, streaming, tools, capability inference or per-model pricing through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents, tools and workflows; @warlock.js/ai-openai for generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

Google Gemini and Imagen adapter for Warlock AI: `GoogleSDK`, `GeminiImageModel`, `GoogleImageModel`, `GoogleCallOptions` and `GOOGLE_MODEL_PRICING`. Use for "connect Gemini", thinking, streaming, tools, embeddings, images or grounded search through `model()`, `embedder()` and `image()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for orchestration; @warlock.js/ai-live for video and realtime sessions.

Groq adapter for Warlock AI: `GroqSDK`, `GROQ_KNOWN_MODELS`, `GROQ_DEFAULT_PRICING`, `inferVisionCapability` and `inferReasoningCapability`. Use for "connect Groq", fast chat, streaming, tools, model capabilities or pricing overrides through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents and custom tools; @warlock.js/ai-openai for generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

Video generation and realtime voice sessions for Warlock AI. Importing this package mounts `ai.video` and `ai.realtime`; exports `video`, `realtime`, `VideoModelContract`, `RealtimeTransport`, `MockVideoModel` and `MockRealtimeTransport`. Use for "generate a video", "duplex voice", audio events or per-second costs. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for chat, still images, speech and one-shot transcription.

Mistral adapter for Warlock AI: `MistralSDK`, `MISTRAL_MODELS`, `MISTRAL_DEFAULT_PRICING`, `inferVisionCapability` and `inferReasoningCapability`. Use for "connect Mistral", streaming, tools, vision, reasoning, capability inference or pricing overrides through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents and workflows; @warlock.js/ai-openai for generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

Local Ollama models for Warlock AI: `OllamaSDK`, `OllamaCallOptions`, `OllamaModelConfig` and `OllamaEmbedderConfig`. Use for "run a local LLM", "connect Ollama", pull model tags, stream chat, use tools, configure thinking or generate embeddings through `model()` and `embedder()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents and RAG; @warlock.js/ai-openai for hosted OpenAI-compatible servers.

OpenAI and compatible endpoints for Warlock AI: `OpenAISDK`, `OpenAIEmbedder`, `OpenAIImageModel`, `kimiSearchTool`, `kimiFetchTool` and pricing registries. Use for "connect OpenAI", Responses or Chat Completions, reasoning, caching, embeddings, images, speech, transcription or Kimi search. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents; @warlock.js/ai-anthropic for Claude; @warlock.js/ai-ollama for local Ollama.

AI tracing, usage, cost analysis and dashboards: `panoptic`, `createCollector`, `createInMemoryTraceStore`, `consoleExporter`, `otelExporter`, `langfuseExporter` and `dashboard`. Use for "trace an agent run", "compare prompt costs", "export spans" or "inspect the AI dashboard". Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for running agents and evals; @warlock.js/logger for logs; @warlock.js/devtools for HTTP debugging.

Ready-made AI tools and MCP client/server support: `mcp`, `serve`, `webSearchTool`, `fetchUrlTool`, `httpRequestTool`, `calculatorTool` and `dateTimeTool`; also mounts `ai.mcp` and `ai.tools`. Use for "connect an MCP server", "serve tools over MCP", "search the web" or "fetch a URL". Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for custom tools and agents; @warlock.js/ai-workspace for filesystem and shell tools.

Policy-confined file and shell tools for coding agents: `workspace`, `createLocalBackend`, `createMockBackend`, `makeEditFileTool`, `makeRunShellTool` and `WorkspacePolicyError`. Use for "let an agent edit files", "sandbox shell commands" or "loop until tests pass". Not this package → @warlock.js/ai-tools for MCP/web tools; @warlock.js/ai for agents; @warlock.js/ai-cli for installed coding CLIs.

xAI Grok adapter for Warlock AI: `XaiSDK`, `XAI_CHAT_MODELS`, `inferVisionCapability`, `inferReasoningCapability` and `XaiModelConfig`. Use for "connect Grok", streaming, tools, vision, reasoning, model capabilities or pricing overrides through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents, tools and workflows; @warlock.js/ai-openai for generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

JWT authentication, refresh rotation, sessions, OTP and passkeys for Warlock apps. Exports `Auth`, `authService`, `authMiddleware`, `currentUser` and `GoogleProvider`. Use for "log in", "protect a route", "reset a password", "sign in with Google" or multiple user types. Not this package → @warlock.js/access for roles and permission policies; @warlock.js/core for general middleware; @warlock.js/seal for input rules.

Pluggable memory, LRU, file, Redis and Postgres caching: `cache`, `cached`, `CacheManager`, `TaggedCache`, `ScopedCache` and `MockCacheDriver`. Use for "cache this query", "invalidate a tenant", "stale-while-revalidate", "take a lock", tag invalidation or counters. Not this package → @warlock.js/core for HTTP response caching; @warlock.js/web for page caching; @warlock.js/cascade for persistent models.

Database models and query builders for MongoDB and SQL: `Model`, `DataSource`, `defineModel`, `registerModel`, `afterCommit` and `modelSync`. Use for "query a table", "define a relation", "write a migration", "run a transaction", eager loading or model events. Not this package → @warlock.js/seal for structural validation; @warlock.js/core for HTTP handlers and repositories; @warlock.js/cache for transient data.

Typed async context propagation with `Context` and `ContextManager`, built on AsyncLocalStorage. Use for "avoid passing the tenant everywhere", request-scoped users, trace IDs, `run`, `enter`, `get`, `set` or coordinating several contexts. Not this package → @warlock.js/core for the framework request context; @warlock.js/cache for state shared across requests; @warlock.js/cascade for database transactions.

Warlock application runtime: `router`, `Request`, `Response`, `config`, `env`, `sendMail` and `defineConfig`. Use for "add an API route", controllers, middleware, CLI commands, config, uploads, mail, sockets, OpenAPI, testing or upgrades. Not this package → @warlock.js/web for React SSR pages; @warlock.js/cascade for database queries; @warlock.js/seal for standalone schemas; @warlock.js/auth for login.

Scaffold Warlock apps with `npm create warlock@latest` or `npx create-warlock`; the CLI entry exports `parseFlags`, `packageVersion` and default `createApp`. Use for "create a project", "start a backend or SSR app", choose a database, AI adapters, features or linting, and automate setup with `--yes` and `--pm=npm`. Not this package → @warlock.js/core for extending an existing app; @warlock.js/web for page APIs.

Development dashboard for Warlock apps via `devtoolsConnector`. Inspect request timelines, middleware, validation, queries, N+1 warnings, logs, cache, mail, AI runs, routes and configuration. Use for "debug a slow endpoint", "inspect this request", "view captured mail" or "open devtools". Not this package → @warlock.js/core for `warlock trace`, CLI route inspection and OpenAPI; @warlock.js/ai-panoptic for AI tracing.

Filesystem helpers with sync names and `Async` variants: `fs`, `File`, `Directory`, `getJsonFileAsync`, `atomicWriteAsync`, `hashFileAsync` and `createConfinedReader`. Use for "read JSON", "write atomically", "copy a directory", "hash a file" or "read a folder without escaping it". Not this package → @warlock.js/core for uploads/storage; @warlock.js/ai-workspace for agent file tools with policy enforcement.

Broker messaging over RabbitMQ: `connectToBroker`, `herald`, `heraldChannel`, `defineEvent`, `defineConsumer`, `EventMessage` and `EventConsumer`. Use for "publish an event", "subscribe to a channel", "ack or nack", "request and reply" or cross-service pub/sub. Not this package → @warlock.js/queue for durable retried background jobs; @warlock.js/scheduler for cron; @warlock.js/notifications for user notifications.

Structured logging with channels, filtering, redaction and shutdown flushing: `log`, `Logger`, `LogChannel`, `ConsoleLog`, `JSONFileLog`, `SentryLog` and `applyRedact`. Use for "log an error with context", "hide tokens", "write JSON logs", "send errors to Sentry" or "flush before exit". Not this package → @warlock.js/core for HTTP error responses; @warlock.js/ai-panoptic for agent traces and AI cost dashboards.

Define once and notify through mail, in-app or custom channels: `defineNotification`, `notify`, `defineChannel`, `mailChannel`, `inApp`, `bullmqQueue` and `heraldQueue`. Use for "notify a user", "show unread notifications", "add a webhook channel" or "queue notification delivery". Not this package → @warlock.js/core for plain email and templates; @warlock.js/queue for jobs; @warlock.js/herald for broker messaging.

Supervise owned child processes with `supervisor`, `ProcessNotOwnedError` and `UnsupportedProcessPlatformError`. Use for "start and stop a process", readiness checks, restart backoff, line-buffered output, IPC, graceful shutdown, pipelines or optional PTY sessions. Not this package → @warlock.js/queue for background jobs; @warlock.js/scheduler for cron; @warlock.js/ai-cli for coding-agent CLI adapters.

Background jobs with BullMQ/Redis, local SQLite or memory: `defineJob`, `queueConnector`, `startWorkers`, `closeQueue`, `failedJobs` and `mountQueueDashboard`. Use for "run in the background", "retry a job", "delay work", "survive restarts" or "view the job dashboard". Not this package → @warlock.js/scheduler for recurring schedules; @warlock.js/herald for pub/sub; @warlock.js/core for the in-memory `Queue` batcher.

In-process cron and fluent scheduling: `Scheduler`, `scheduler`, `Job`, `job`, `CronParser` and `parseCron`. Use for "run every day at 3am", "schedule weekdays", "retry a failing job", "prevent overlap", choose a timezone or observe job failures. Not this package → @warlock.js/queue for durable background workers; @warlock.js/cache for locks across instances; @warlock.js/herald for broker messaging.

Framework-independent typed validation: `v`, `validate`, `ObjectValidator`, `StringValidator` and `Infer`. Use for "validate a request body", "require an email", optional fields and defaults, schema type inference, custom rules, JSON Schema or Standard Schema. Not this package → @warlock.js/core for database rules and upload validators; @warlock.js/cascade for model schemas and persistence.

Framework-independent XML sitemap builders: `Sitemap`, `SitemapIndex`, `buildSitemapXml`, `joinOrigin` and `SitemapEntry`. Use for "generate sitemap XML", URL metadata, hreflang, image entries, sharding, duplicate diagnostics or atomic publication from scripts and servers. Not this package → @warlock.js/web for Warlock page discovery, `/sitemap.xml` and robots routing; @warlock.js/core for app configuration.

React SSR pages with Vite: `Link`, `href`, `defer`, `shared`, `useShared`, `Form`, `Head`, `Image`, `useTrans` and `navigateTo`. Use for "add a page", "load page data", stream loaders, layouts, forms/actions, sessions, themes, localization, metadata or sitemaps. Not this package → @warlock.js/core for API routes, mail and storage; @warlock.js/cascade for queries; @warlock.js/seal for input validation.
